'''Ad'lestaa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[engineer]] who crossed the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Unusual Cargo|Coruscant}}</ref>, she was placed into a crate and set to be shipped off-world, but was rescued by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned individual.
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ad'lestaa is the subject of a hidden achievement called "Unusual Cargo" in the Dynamic Encounters on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encounter" />
